author: Indicado
body:
I recently got noticed about a program called "Discord". It is like Slack but you can talk with people like TeamSpeak. Since here in the tournament staff we use slack and staff too, i think it will be better for everyone.

You can set your own server free and not like slack,you can be in 2 servers at the same time.

Try it here

replies.author: GuyNamedRiley
replies.body:
@iron and @jahaj. You can be in up to 100 discord chats at a time. And plus it is so much easier to switch because all of the chat windows are pre loaded when you start up the application. Also, it isn't more difficult to use than TS if you take time to learn it.

@ALM, the permission system actually works great. You can provide temporary invite codes to servers for a limited use, you can get a link to the discord instead of having to get everyones emails, and you can now have multiple owners.

A couple other things like like about it, is that you have an ingame overlay so you can determine who is talking and switch chats when needed.

All in all it is better so you should probs switch. but TBH you probably won't switch because not many people can adapt to change, staff included.

#BeenABetaTesterSince2YearsAgo
